' CHAOTIC - an abstract shooter for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' You are the claw on the rim of a web of 16 lanes, seen down its length. Things climb up the
' lanes out of the middle, firing; you slide round the rim and shoot down the lanes. 16 webs,
' then round again faster. From DEFENDER HELLGATE: the pickups (P, big P, gems, G, N), the power
' levels, the GUARD, the smart bomb (the NOVA here) and the HIT chain. Every fourth level a CORE
' sits in the middle of the web and fills the screen with bullets.
'
' Keys: O P (or Q A on up-and-down edges, or the joystick) slide round the rim - left is left on
'       the screen wherever you are. Space (fire 1) fires (hold it). M (fire 2) the GUARD. N the NOVA.
'
' Layer 2 (Web.cls) holds the web, drawn once a level, and the particles (in Z80, over it);
' every line of the web is a palette colour of its own, so a lane lights up by changing a
' colour, not by drawing. The copper (Cop.cls) paints the background a line at a time and
' wobbles Layer 2. The things in the web, your shots and the pickups are sprites, three sizes by
' how far down the web they are; their bullets are sprites moved in Z80 (Bul.cls). The panel is
' the tilemap, in the top border.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const NE = 20, NS = 8, NI = 6
' sprite slots (Bul has 64-127)
Const SP_CLAW = 0, SP_GUARD = 1, SP_SHOT = 2, SP_ITEM = 10, SP_EN = 16, SP_CORE = 40
' depth: 0 the middle, RIM the rim (64 steps of 64)
Const RIM = 4096
' the things in the web
Const K_SNAP = 1, K_POD = 2, K_SPIN = 3, K_PULS = 4, K_SEED = 5, K_FUSE = 6
' Layer 2's colour numbers: the spokes (17), the rim and inner edges (16), the rings, the particles'
' colour ramps (8 of 8)
Const C_SPOKE = 1, C_SEG = 20, C_RING = 40, C_RAMP = 64
Const R_FIRE = 64, R_ICE = 72, R_ACID = 80, R_VIOLET = 88, R_GOLD = 96, R_WHITE = 104, R_BLOOD = 112, R_PINK = 120
' bullet colours (sprite palettes)
Const B_PINK = 2, B_CYAN = 3, B_GOLD = 4, B_GREEN = 5
Const GUARDLEN = 100

' the web: lane k's middle at depth d (0-64) is at lx(k * 65 + d), ly(...)
Dim lx(1039) As Byte, ly(1039) As Byte
Dim rx(16) As Integer, ry(16) As Integer, ix(16) As Integer, iy(16) As Integer
Dim cdir(15) As Integer, dirX(15) As Integer, dirY(15) As Integer, tt(64) As Integer
Dim lcol(15) As Integer, lwas(15) As Integer, zap(15) As Integer, spWas(16) As Integer
Dim cX As Integer, cY As Integer, isClosed As Integer, shape As Integer, webC As Integer, hiC As Integer, ringC As Integer, ringB As Integer
' the things: kind, lane, depth (0 - RIM), speed, life, timer, on the rim, hit flash, an angle
Dim ek(19) As Integer, el(19) As Integer, ez(19) As Integer, ev(19) As Integer, ehp(19) As Integer
Dim et(19) As Integer, es(19) As Integer, ef(19) As Integer, ea(19) As Integer
' your shots: lane (-1 none), depth
Dim sl(7) As Integer, sz(7) As Integer
' pickups: kind (0 none; 1 P, 2 big P, 3 a gem, 4 G, 5 N), lane, depth, time on the rim
Dim ik(5) As Integer, il(5) As Integer, iz(5) As Integer, it(5) As Integer
' you
Dim ppos As Integer, plane As Integer, pX As Integer, pY As Integer, alive As Integer, inv As Integer, deadT As Integer
Dim power As Integer, pCount As Integer, pTotal As Integer, lives As Integer, novas As Integer, guards As Integer, guardT As Integer
Dim shotCool As Integer, novaWas As Integer, guardWas As Integer, fireAnim As Integer
Dim score As Long, hiscore As Long, nextExtend As Long
Dim chain As Integer, chainT As Integer, maxChain As Integer
' the level
Dim level As Integer, quota As Integer, spawned As Integer, spawnT As Integer, alivee As Integer, maxOn As Integer
Dim frames As Integer, wob As Integer, flashT As Integer, flashC As Integer, msgT As Integer, phase As Integer
Dim bulSpd As Integer, dirty As Integer, over As Integer, warpT As Integer
' the core
Dim bossOn As Integer, bossHP As Integer, bossMax As Integer, bossGap As Integer, bossT As Integer, bossAng As Integer
Dim bossDie As Integer, bossF As Integer, coreBeat As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer, t As Integer
Dim nm As String Max 12

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Bul.Init
L2On
Web.Init
Cop.Build 0, 0, 0
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderUSL                   ' the tilemap on top (the panel), the sprites, Layer 2
Ramps
hiscore = 50000
Do
  Title
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the screen
' Layer 2 on: 256 x 192, bank 16, no scroll, the whole of it; colour 0 see-through
Sub L2On()
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Nx.Reg &H14, &HE3
  Out &H123B, 2
  Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, 0, &HE3
End Sub

' the particles' 8 colour ramps (brightest first)
Sub Ramps()
  Ramp R_FIRE, "FCF8F4F0E0C08040"
  Ramp R_ICE, "BF9F5F1F170F0A05"
  Ramp R_ACID, "BDBC9C987C584C24"
  Ramp R_VIOLET, "F7D7B79B934A2501"
  Ramp R_GOLD, "FEFDFCF8F4D0A864"
  Ramp R_WHITE, "FFDBB6926D494924"
  Ramp R_BLOOD, "F4F0E0C0A0806020"
  Ramp R_PINK, "F7EFEBCAC6A56221"
End Sub

Sub Ramp(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal s As String)
  For k = 0 To 7
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, r + k, Hx(s, k)
  Next
End Sub

' Hx(s, k): the k-th hex pair in s
Function Hx(ByVal s As String, ByVal k As Integer) As Integer
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer
  a = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 1, 1)) : b = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 2, 1))
  If a > 57 Then a = a - 55 Else a = a - 48
  If b > 57 Then b = b - 55 Else b = b - 48
  Hx = a * 16 + b
End Function

' Sync: the frame: wait for it, then (in the top border, before the picture starts) the copper's
' list, the particles moved and drawn (one Layer 2 screen: done while it isn't being shown, they
' don't flicker), the sprites; the next frame's copper made
Sub Sync()
  Frame
  Cop.Show
  Web.Step
  Spr.Show
  Bul.Show
  Sfx.Update
  frames = frames + 1
  phase = (phase + 1) And 255
  If wob > 0 Then wob = wob - 1
  If flashT > 0 Then flashT = flashT - 1
  t = wob * 2
  If t > 64 Then t = 64
  If flashT > 0 Then Cop.Build phase, t, flashC Else Cop.Build phase, t, 0
End Sub

' Flash c, n: the background colour c for n frames; and a wobble
Sub Flash(ByVal c As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal w As Integer)
  flashC = c : flashT = n
  If w > wob Then wob = w
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the web
' MakeWeb n: web n (0-15): its points, its lanes' middles at every depth, its look
Sub MakeWeb(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer, d As Integer, x0 As Integer, y0 As Integer, x1 As Integer, y1 As Integer
  Dim p As Integer
  shape = n
  a = Shapes.Webs() + n * Shapes.REC
  For k = 0 To 16
    rx(k) = Peek(a + k) : ry(k) = Peek(a + 17 + k) : ix(k) = Peek(a + 34 + k) : iy(k) = Peek(a + 51 + k)
  Next
  isClosed = Peek(a + 68)
  For k = 0 To 15
    cdir(k) = Peek(a + 72 + k)
    x0 = rx(k + 1) - rx(k) : y0 = ry(k + 1) - ry(k)
    dirX(k) = 0 : dirY(k) = 0
    If Abs(x0) * 3 >= Abs(y0) Then dirX(k) = Sgn(x0)
    If Abs(y0) * 3 >= Abs(x0) Then dirY(k) = Sgn(y0)
  Next
  cX = 0 : cY = 0
  For k = 0 To 15
    cX = cX + ix(k) : cY = cY + iy(k)
  Next
  cX = cX \ 16 : cY = cY \ 16
  b = Shapes.Depth()
  For d = 0 To 64
    tt(d) = Peek(b + d)
  Next
  For k = 0 To 15
    x0 = (ix(k) + ix(k + 1)) \ 2 : y0 = (iy(k) + iy(k + 1)) \ 2
    x1 = (rx(k) + rx(k + 1)) \ 2 : y1 = (ry(k) + ry(k + 1)) \ 2
    p = k * 65
    For d = 0 To 64
      lx(p + d) = x0 + ((x1 - x0) * (tt(d) \ 2)) \ 128
      ly(p + d) = y0 + ((y1 - y0) * (tt(d) \ 2)) \ 128
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' the web's colours for level lv: 4 looks, round and round
Sub WebLook(ByVal lv As Integer)
  Select Case ((lv - 1) \ 4) Mod 4
    Case 0
      webC = &H17 : hiC = &HFC : ringC = &H06 : ringB = &H2F
      GradSet 0
    Case 1
      webC = &HE0 : hiC = &HFC : ringC = &H40 : ringB = &HA4
      GradSet 1
    Case 2
      webC = &H1C : hiC = &HFF : ringC = &H08 : ringB = &H5D
      GradSet 2
    Case Else
      webC = &HC7 : hiC = &HFC : ringC = &H42 : ringB = &HAB
      GradSet 3
  End Select
  For k = 0 To 16
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_SPOKE + k, webC
    spWas(k) = webC
  Next
  For k = 0 To 15
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_SEG + k, webC
    lwas(k) = webC
  Next
  For k = 0 To 3
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_RING + k, ringC
  Next
End Sub

' the background's band of colours: 8 dark ones, up and down (each 8 lines deep: it rolls)
Sub GradSet(ByVal g As Integer)
  Dim c As Integer, h As Integer, st As String
  Select Case g
    Case 0 : st = "000001010202060A"
    Case 1 : st = "0020202140416162"
    Case 2 : st = "000404050809090D"
    Case Else : st = "0001212122424363"
  End Select
  For k = 0 To 255
    h = k And 63
    If h > 31 Then h = 63 - h
    c = Hx(st, h \ 4)
    Cop.Grad k, c
  Next
End Sub

' DrawWeb: the web on the (cleared) screen, a lane at a time with a frame between (so it grows)
Sub DrawWeb(ByVal slow As Integer)
  Dim r As Integer, d As Integer, x0 As Integer, y0 As Integer, x1 As Integer, y1 As Integer, nk As Integer
  If isClosed Then nk = 15 Else nk = 16
  ' the rings
  For r = 0 To 2
    If r = 0 Then d = 22
    If r = 1 Then d = 38
    If r = 2 Then d = 52
    For k = 0 To 15
      x0 = ix(k) + ((rx(k) - ix(k)) * (tt(d) \ 2)) \ 128
      y0 = iy(k) + ((ry(k) - iy(k)) * (tt(d) \ 2)) \ 128
      x1 = ix(k + 1) + ((rx(k + 1) - ix(k + 1)) * (tt(d) \ 2)) \ 128
      y1 = iy(k + 1) + ((ry(k + 1) - iy(k + 1)) * (tt(d) \ 2)) \ 128
      Web.Line x0, y0, x1, y1, C_RING + r
    Next
  Next
  For k = 0 To nk
    Web.Line ix(k), iy(k), rx(k), ry(k), C_SPOKE + k
    If k < 16 Then
      Web.Line ix(k), iy(k), ix(k + 1), iy(k + 1), C_SEG + k
      Web.Line rx(k), ry(k), rx(k + 1), ry(k + 1), C_SEG + k
    End If
    If slow Then Sync : Sfx.Play 2, 400 - k * 20, 0, 8, 3, 0
  Next
End Sub

' Lights: the lanes' colours this frame - yours lit, a pulsar's zapping, the rings pulsing out
Sub Lights()
  Dim c As Integer, a As Integer, b As Integer
  For k = 0 To 15
    c = webC
    If alive And k = plane Then c = hiC
    If zap(k) Then
      If frames And 2 Then c = &HFF Else c = &HE0
    End If
    lcol(k) = c
    If c <> lwas(k) Then Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_SEG + k, c : lwas(k) = c
  Next
  For k = 0 To 16
    a = k - 1 : b = k
    If a < 0 Then
      If isClosed Then a = 15 Else a = 0
    End If
    If b > 15 Then
      If isClosed Then b = 0 Else b = 15
    End If
    c = lcol(b)
    If lcol(a) <> webC Then c = lcol(a)
    If lcol(b) <> webC Then c = lcol(b)
    If c <> spWas(k) Then Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_SPOKE + k, c : spWas(k) = c
  Next
  ' a ring of light running out along the web
  If (frames And 3) = 0 Then
    a = (frames \ 4) Mod 6
    For k = 0 To 2
      If k = a Then c = ringB Else c = ringC
      Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_RING + k, c
    Next
  End If
End Sub

' LaneX(l, z), LaneY(l, z): where lane l's middle at depth z is (pixels)
Function LaneX(ByVal l As Integer, ByVal z As Integer) As Integer
  If z > RIM Then z = RIM
  If z < 0 Then z = 0
  LaneX = lx(l * 65 + z \ 64)
End Function

Function LaneY(ByVal l As Integer, ByVal z As Integer) As Integer
  If z > RIM Then z = RIM
  If z < 0 Then z = 0
  LaneY = ly(l * 65 + z \ 64)
End Function

' the lane next to l, way w (-1, 1): -1 off the end of an open web
Function Next1(ByVal l As Integer, ByVal w As Integer) As Integer
  l = l + w
  If isClosed Then
    Next1 = l And 15
  ElseIf l < 0 Or l > 15 Then
    Next1 = -1
  Else
    Next1 = l
  End If
End Function

' the way (-1, 0, 1) from lane a towards lane b, the short way round
Function Toward(ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer) As Integer
  Dim d As Integer
  d = b - a
  If isClosed Then
    If d > 8 Then d = d - 16
    If d < -8 Then d = d + 16
  End If
  Toward = Sgn(d)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the panel
Sub Panel()
  Tiles.Rect 0, 0, 40, 3, GfxData.T_PANEL
  Tiles.Rect 0, 3, 40, 1, GfxData.T_PANELB
  Tiles.Text 1, 1, "SCORE"
  Tiles.Text 26, 0, "HI"
  Tiles.Text 1, 2, "LV"
  Tiles.Text 9, 2, "POW"
  Tiles.Text 19, 2, "HIT"
  ScoreText
  HudText
End Sub

Sub ScoreText()
  Tiles.Text 7, 1, Right$("0000000" & Mid$(Str$(score), 2), 8)
  Tiles.Text 29, 0, Right$("0000000" & Mid$(Str$(hiscore), 2), 8)
End Sub

Sub HudText()
  Dim g As Integer
  Tiles.Text 4, 2, Right$(" " & CStr(level), 3)
  Tiles.Rect 13, 2, 5, 1, GfxData.T_PANEL
  For k = 0 To 4
    If k < power - 1 Then g = 4 Else g = 0
    If k = power - 1 Then g = pCount \ 2
    If g > 4 Then g = 4
    If k < power Then Tiles.Put 13 + k, 2, GfxData.T_PGAUGE + g Else Tiles.Put 13 + k, 2, GfxData.T_PGAUGE
  Next
  Tiles.Rect 26, 1, 13, 2, GfxData.T_PANEL
  For k = 0 To 5
    If k < lives - 1 Then Tiles.Put 26 + k, 1, GfxData.T_LIFE
  Next
  For k = 0 To 5
    If k < novas Then Tiles.Put 26 + k, 2, GfxData.T_NOVA
    If k < guards Then Tiles.Put 33 + k, 2, GfxData.T_GUARDT
  Next
  ChainText
End Sub

Sub ChainText()
  Dim g As Integer
  g = chainT \ 8
  If g > 8 Then g = 8
  Tiles.Put 23, 2, GfxData.T_GAUGE + g
  If chain > 1 Then Tiles.Text 24, 2, Left$(CStr(chain) & " ", 2) Else Tiles.Text 24, 2, "  "
End Sub

Sub AddScore(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  If score > hiscore Then hiscore = score
  If score >= nextExtend Then
    nextExtend = nextExtend + 40000
    If lives < 6 Then lives = lives + 1 : Msg "EXTRA CLAW", 60 : Sfx.Play 2, 60, -1, 15, 30, 0
    HudText
  End If
  ScoreText
End Sub

' Msg s, t: a line in the middle of the screen for t frames
Sub Msg(ByVal s As String, ByVal t As Integer)
  Tiles.Rect 4, 15, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Text 20 - Len(s) \ 2, 15, s
  msgT = t
End Sub

Sub MsgOff()
  Tiles.Rect 4, 15, 32, 1, 0
  Tiles.Rect 4, 17, 32, 1, 0
  msgT = 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game
Sub Game()
  score = 0 : lives = 4 : novas = 2 : guards = 3 : power = 1 : pCount = 0 : pTotal = 0
  nextExtend = 40000 : chain = 0 : chainT = 0 : maxChain = 0 : level = 1 : over = 0
  Tiles.Fill 0
  Panel
  StartLevel 1
  Do
    Play
    If over Then Exit Do
    Warp
    level = level + 1
    StartLevel 0
  Loop
  GameOver
End Sub

' StartLevel first: the web for this level drawn, everything cleared
Sub StartLevel(ByVal first As Integer)
  Clean
  MakeWeb (level - 1) Mod 16
  WebLook level
  Web.Clear
  Web.Kill
  HudText
  Msg "LEVEL " & CStr(level), 120
  nm = WebName(shape)
  Tiles.Text 20 - Len(nm) \ 2, 17, nm
  DrawWeb 1
  quota = 14 + level * 2
  If quota > 60 Then quota = 60
  maxOn = 4 + level \ 2
  If maxOn > 16 Then maxOn = 16
  bulSpd = 14 + level
  If bulSpd > 40 Then bulSpd = 40
  spawned = 0 : spawnT = 60 : bossOn = 0 : bossDie = 0 : coreBeat = 0
  ppos = 8 : plane = 0
  If isClosed = 0 Then ppos = 8 * 16 + 8 : plane = 8
  Spawn5
  alive = 1 : inv = 90 : deadT = 0 : guardT = 0
End Sub

' Spawn5: if the first lane's at the top, start at the bottom
Sub Spawn5()
  Dim best As Integer, by As Integer
  best = plane : by = -1
  For k = 0 To 15
    If LaneY(k, RIM) > by Then by = LaneY(k, RIM) : best = k
  Next
  plane = best : ppos = best * 16 + 8
End Sub

Function WebName(ByVal n As Integer) As String
  Select Case n
    Case 0 : WebName = "CIRCLE"
    Case 1 : WebName = "SQUARE"
    Case 2 : WebName = "CROSS"
    Case 3 : WebName = "FLAT"
    Case 4 : WebName = "STAR"
    Case 5 : WebName = "VEE"
    Case 6 : WebName = "TRIANGLE"
    Case 7 : WebName = "BOW TIE"
    Case 8 : WebName = "U"
    Case 9 : WebName = "HEART"
    Case 10 : WebName = "STEPS"
    Case 11 : WebName = "HEXAGON"
    Case 12 : WebName = "WAVE"
    Case 13 : WebName = "PEANUT"
    Case 14 : WebName = "DOUBLE VEE"
    Case Else : WebName = "DIAMOND"
  End Select
End Function

' everything off the web
Sub Clean()
  For k = 0 To NE - 1
    ek(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To NS - 1
    sl(k) = -1
  Next
  For k = 0 To NI - 1
    ik(k) = 0
  Next
  For k = 0 To 15
    zap(k) = 0
  Next
  Bul.Reset
  Spr.HideRange 0, 64
  bossOn = 0 : bossDie = 0
End Sub

' Play: the level, until it's cleared (or you're out of claws)
Sub Play()
  Do
    Sync
    Controls
    Shots
    Things
    If bossOn Then Core
    Items
    Bul.Step pX, pY, 3
    If Bul.Hit() And alive And inv = 0 And guardT = 0 Then Die
    If guardT > 0 Then
      guardT = guardT - 1
      t = Bul.Clear()
      If t > 0 Then GuardEat t
    End If
    Lights
    Draw
    If chainT > 0 Then
      chainT = chainT - 1
      If (chainT And 7) = 0 Then ChainText
      If chainT = 0 Then chain = 0 : ChainText
    End If
    If msgT > 0 Then
      msgT = msgT - 1
      If msgT = 0 Then MsgOff
    End If
    If alive = 0 Then
      deadT = deadT - 1
      If deadT = 0 Then
        If lives = 0 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
        Respawn
      End If
    End If
    ' more of them
    spawnT = spawnT - 1
    If spawnT <= 0 And alive Then
      spawnT = 50 - level * 2
      If spawnT < 14 Then spawnT = 14
      If spawned < quota And alivee < maxOn Then NewThing : spawned = spawned + 1
    End If
    ' done: all spawned, none left - or the core, every fourth level
    If spawned >= quota And alivee = 0 And alive And bossOn = 0 Then
      If (level Mod 4) = 0 And coreBeat = 0 Then
        StartCore
      Else
        Exit Do
      End If
    End If
  Loop
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- you
Sub Controls()
  Dim j As Integer, mv As Integer, lf As Integer, rt As Integer, up As Integer, dn As Integer
  Dim f As Integer, a As Integer, b As Integer, w As Integer
  If inv > 0 Then inv = inv - 1
  If alive = 0 Then Exit Sub
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  lf = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j And Keys.JoyLeft)
  rt = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j And Keys.JoyRight)
  up = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (j And Keys.JoyUp)
  dn = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (j And Keys.JoyDown)
  mv = 0
  If rt Then mv = mv + dirX(plane)
  If lf Then mv = mv - dirX(plane)
  If dn Then mv = mv + dirY(plane)
  If up Then mv = mv - dirY(plane)
  If mv > 0 Then ppos = ppos + 4
  If mv < 0 Then ppos = ppos - 4
  If isClosed Then
    ppos = ppos And 255
  Else
    If ppos < 8 Then ppos = 8
    If ppos > 248 Then ppos = 248
  End If
  ' no key: settle on the lane's middle
  If mv = 0 Then
    a = ppos And 15
    If a < 8 Then ppos = ppos + 1
    If a > 8 Then ppos = ppos - 1
    If isClosed Then ppos = ppos And 255
  End If
  plane = ppos \ 16
  ' where that is: between this lane's middle and the next one's
  a = (ppos And 15) - 8
  pX = LaneX(plane, RIM) : pY = LaneY(plane, RIM)
  If a <> 0 Then
    w = Next1(plane, Sgn(a))
    If w >= 0 Then
      pX = pX + ((LaneX(w, RIM) - pX) * Abs(a)) \ 16
      pY = pY + ((LaneY(w, RIM) - pY) * Abs(a)) \ 16
    End If
  End If
  ' fire
  f = Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or ((j And Keys.JoyFire1) <> 0)
  If shotCool > 0 Then shotCool = shotCool - 1
  If f And shotCool = 0 Then
    FireShot plane
    If power = 5 Or (power >= 3 And (frames And 1)) Then
      w = Next1(plane, -1)
      If w >= 0 Then FireShot w
      w = Next1(plane, 1)
      If w >= 0 Then FireShot w
    End If
    Select Case power
      Case 1 : shotCool = 8
      Case 2 : shotCool = 6
      Case 3 : shotCool = 6
      Case Else : shotCool = 4
    End Select
    fireAnim = 3
    Sfx.Play 0, 40, 6, 11, 5, 0
  End If
  ' the guard
  b = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or ((j And Keys.JoyFire2) <> 0)
  If b And guardWas = 0 And guards > 0 And guardT = 0 Then
    guards = guards - 1 : guardT = GUARDLEN
    Sfx.Play 2, 30, 2, 15, 30, 0
    Msg "GUARD", 40
    HudText
  End If
  guardWas = b
  ' the nova
  b = Keys.Down(Keys.KeyN)
  If b And novaWas = 0 And novas > 0 Then Nova
  novaWas = b
End Sub

Sub FireShot(ByVal l As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NS - 1
    If sl(n) < 0 Then
      sl(n) = l : sz(n) = RIM
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' Shots: down their lanes; a thing in the lane near enough is hit
Sub Shots()
  Dim n As Integer, e As Integer, sp As Integer, dmg As Integer
  sp = 230
  If power >= 4 Then sp = 300
  For n = 0 To NS - 1
    If sl(n) >= 0 Then
      sz(n) = sz(n) - sp
      If sz(n) <= 0 Then
        If bossOn And bossDie = 0 Then CoreShot sl(n)
        sl(n) = -1
      Else
        e = 0
        Do While e < NE
          If ek(e) > 0 Then
            If el(e) = sl(n) And ez(e) >= sz(n) - 120 And ez(e) <= sz(n) + sp + 120 Then
              dmg = 1
              If power = 5 Then dmg = 2
              Hurt e, dmg
              sl(n) = -1
              e = NE
            End If
          End If
          e = e + 1
        Loop
      End If
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the things
Sub NewThing()
  Dim n As Integer, kd As Integer, r As Integer
  n = FreeThing()
  If n < 0 Then Exit Sub
  r = Rnd(100)
  kd = K_SNAP
  If level >= 2 And r < 25 Then kd = K_POD
  If level >= 3 And r >= 25 And r < 40 Then kd = K_SPIN
  If level >= 5 And r >= 40 And r < 52 Then kd = K_SEED
  If level >= 7 And r >= 52 And r < 60 Then kd = K_PULS
  If level >= 9 And r >= 60 And r < 68 Then kd = K_FUSE
  Put1 n, kd, Rnd(16), 0
End Sub

Function FreeThing() As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(n) = 0 Then FreeThing = n : Exit Function
  Next
  FreeThing = -1
End Function

' Put1 n, kind, lane, depth: thing n
Sub Put1(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal l As Integer, ByVal z As Integer)
  ek(n) = kd : el(n) = l : ez(n) = z : es(n) = 0 : ef(n) = 0 : ea(n) = Rnd(256)
  et(n) = 30 + Rnd(60)
  Select Case kd
    Case K_SNAP : ev(n) = 10 + level * 2 : ehp(n) = 1
    Case K_POD : ev(n) = 7 + level : ehp(n) = 2
    Case K_SPIN : ev(n) = 12 + level : ehp(n) = 2
    Case K_PULS : ev(n) = 9 + level : ehp(n) = 3
    Case K_SEED : ev(n) = 10 + level : ehp(n) = 3 + level \ 4 : et(n) = 1200 + Rnd(1600)
    Case Else : ev(n) = 24 + level * 2 : ehp(n) = 1
  End Select
  If ev(n) > 60 Then ev(n) = 60
End Sub

' Hurt n, d: thing n takes d
Sub Hurt(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal d As Integer)
  ehp(n) = ehp(n) - d
  ef(n) = 4
  If ehp(n) <= 0 Then
    Boom n, 1
  Else
    Sfx.Play 1, 200, -10, 10, 4, 1
  End If
End Sub

' Boom n, drops: thing n blown up (drops: its pickups too)
Sub Boom(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal drops As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, sc As Integer, r As Integer, l As Integer, m As Integer
  x = LaneX(el(n), ez(n)) : y = LaneY(el(n), ez(n))
  Select Case ek(n)
    Case K_SNAP : sc = 150 : r = R_BLOOD
    Case K_POD : sc = 200 : r = R_VIOLET
    Case K_SPIN : sc = 250 : r = R_ACID
    Case K_PULS : sc = 300 : r = R_ICE
    Case K_SEED : sc = 500 : r = R_FIRE
    Case Else : sc = 750 : r = R_PINK
  End Select
  ' the size of the bang: the nearer, the bigger
  m = 12 + ez(n) \ 160
  Web.Burst x, y, m, r, 20 + ez(n) \ 128, 0, 30
  If ez(n) > 2400 Then Web.Burst x, y, 12, R_WHITE, 44, 1, 22
  Sfx.Play 1, 600 + Rnd(400), 20, 14, 18, 1
  ' a pod lets out its two snappers
  If ek(n) = K_POD And drops Then
    l = el(n)
    ek(n) = 0
    m = Next1(l, -1)
    If m < 0 Then m = l
    Put1 n, K_SNAP, m, ez(n)
    m = FreeThing()
    If m >= 0 Then
      x = Next1(l, 1)
      If x < 0 Then x = l
      Put1 m, K_SNAP, x, ez(n)
    End If
  Else
    If drops Then Drop el(n), ez(n), ek(n)
    ek(n) = 0
  End If
  ' the HIT chain
  If chainT > 0 Then chain = chain + 1 Else chain = 1
  If chain > maxChain Then maxChain = chain
  chainT = 64
  ChainText
  AddScore sc + 10 * chain
End Sub

' Drop l, z, kind: what a thing leaves (DEFENDER HELLGATE's pickups)
Sub Drop(ByVal l As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal kd As Integer)
  Dim r As Integer
  r = Rnd(100)
  If kd = K_SEED Or kd = K_PULS Then r = r \ 2
  If r < 4 Then
    NewItem 2, l, z
  ElseIf r < 26 Then
    NewItem 1, l, z
  ElseIf r < 38 Then
    NewItem 3, l, z
  ElseIf r < 40 Then
    NewItem 4, l, z
  ElseIf r < 42 Then
    NewItem 5, l, z
  End If
End Sub

' Things: every thing in the web, a frame on
Sub Things()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, a As Integer, w As Integer
  alivee = 0
  For k = 0 To 15
    zap(k) = 0
  Next
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(n) > 0 Then
      alivee = alivee + 1
      If ef(n) > 0 Then ef(n) = ef(n) - 1
      et(n) = et(n) - 1
      x = LaneX(el(n), ez(n)) : y = LaneY(el(n), ez(n))
      Select Case ek(n)
        Case K_SNAP
          If es(n) = 0 Then
            ez(n) = ez(n) + ev(n)
            If ez(n) >= RIM Then ez(n) = RIM : es(n) = 1 : et(n) = 20
            If et(n) <= 0 Then
              et(n) = 90 - level * 3
              If et(n) < 30 Then et(n) = 30
              If ez(n) > 800 And alive Then Bul.Fire x, y, Bul.Aim(x, y, pX, pY), bulSpd, GfxData.S_BULLET, B_PINK
            End If
          Else
            ' on the rim: it flips along towards you
            If et(n) <= 0 Then
              et(n) = 26 - level
              If et(n) < 8 Then et(n) = 8
              w = Toward(el(n), plane)
              If w <> 0 Then
                a = Next1(el(n), w)
                If a >= 0 Then el(n) = a
              End If
            End If
          End If
        Case K_POD
          ez(n) = ez(n) + ev(n)
          If ez(n) >= RIM Then Boom n, 1
        Case K_SPIN
          ez(n) = ez(n) + ev(n)
          ea(n) = (ea(n) + 7) And 255
          If et(n) <= 0 Then
            et(n) = 40 - level
            If et(n) < 14 Then et(n) = 14
            ' a three-armed spiral
            Bul.Fire x, y, ea(n), bulSpd - 2, GfxData.S_BULLET + 2, B_GREEN
            Bul.Fire x, y, (ea(n) + 85) And 255, bulSpd - 2, GfxData.S_BULLET + 2, B_GREEN
            Bul.Fire x, y, (ea(n) + 170) And 255, bulSpd - 2, GfxData.S_BULLET + 2, B_GREEN
            ' and it slips to the next lane
            a = Next1(el(n), 1 - Rnd(2) * 2)
            If a >= 0 Then el(n) = a
          End If
          If ez(n) >= RIM Then ek(n) = K_SNAP : es(n) = 1 : ez(n) = RIM : ehp(n) = 1
        Case K_PULS
          If ez(n) < 2700 Then ez(n) = ez(n) + ev(n)
          ' pulsing: its lane is live for 40 frames in 140
          a = (frames + n * 37) Mod 140
          If a < 40 Then
            zap(el(n)) = 1
            If a = 0 Then Ring x, y, 8, ea(n), bulSpd - 4, B_CYAN : Sfx.Play 2, 20, 0, 12, 40, 1
          End If
        Case K_SEED
          If ez(n) < et(n) \ 1 And es(n) = 0 Then
            ez(n) = ez(n) + ev(n)
          Else
            If es(n) = 0 Then es(n) = 2 : ea(n) = 0
            ea(n) = ea(n) + 1
            a = 84 - level * 2
            If a < 34 Then a = 34
            If ea(n) >= a Then
              ea(n) = 0
              w = 8 + level \ 2
              If w > 16 Then w = 16
              Ring x, y, w, frames And 255, bulSpd - 3, B_GOLD
            End If
          End If
        Case Else
          ' a fuse: fast, hopping lanes; on the rim it hunts you
          If es(n) = 0 Then
            ez(n) = ez(n) + ev(n)
            If et(n) <= 0 Then
              et(n) = 16
              a = Next1(el(n), 1 - Rnd(2) * 2)
              If a >= 0 Then el(n) = a
            End If
            If ez(n) >= RIM Then ez(n) = RIM : es(n) = 1
          ElseIf et(n) <= 0 Then
            et(n) = 6
            w = Toward(el(n), plane)
            If w <> 0 Then
              a = Next1(el(n), w)
              If a >= 0 Then el(n) = a
            End If
          End If
      End Select
      ' on the rim, in your lane: it's got you (the guard burns it)
      If ek(n) > 0 And alive And ez(n) >= RIM - 64 And el(n) = plane Then
        If guardT > 0 Or inv > 0 Then
          If guardT > 0 Then Boom n, 1
        Else
          Boom n, 0
          Die
        End If
      End If
    End If
  Next
  ' a pulsar's lane with you in it
  If alive And zap(plane) And inv = 0 And guardT = 0 Then Die
End Sub

' Ring x, y, n, a0, spd, pal: n bullets evenly round from x, y
Sub Ring(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal a0 As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = 0 To n - 1
    Bul.Fire x, y, (a0 + j * 256 \ n) And 255, sp, GfxData.S_BULLET + 1, pal
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- pickups
Sub NewItem(ByVal kd As Integer, ByVal l As Integer, ByVal z As Integer)
  Dim n As Integer
  For n = 0 To NI - 1
    If ik(n) = 0 Then
      ik(n) = kd : il(n) = l : iz(n) = z : it(n) = 0
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' Items: they float up their lanes to the rim, then slide towards you; touch to take
Sub Items()
  Dim n As Integer, w As Integer
  For n = 0 To NI - 1
    If ik(n) > 0 Then
      If iz(n) < RIM Then
        iz(n) = iz(n) + 48
        If iz(n) > RIM Then iz(n) = RIM
      Else
        it(n) = it(n) + 1
        If it(n) > 240 Then ik(n) = 0
        If (it(n) And 7) = 0 And alive Then
          w = Toward(il(n), plane)
          If w <> 0 Then
            w = Next1(il(n), w)
            If w >= 0 Then il(n) = w
          End If
        End If
      End If
      If ik(n) > 0 And alive And il(n) = plane And iz(n) >= RIM - 400 Then Take n
    End If
  Next
End Sub

Sub Take(ByVal n As Integer)
  Select Case ik(n)
    Case 1
      pCount = pCount + 1 : pTotal = pTotal + 1
      AddScore 100
      If pCount >= 10 Then pCount = 0 : PowerUp
      If (pTotal Mod 25) = 0 Then guards = guards + 1 : Msg "GUARD +1", 40
      Sfx.Play 2, 120, -4, 13, 8, 0
    Case 2
      PowerUp
      Sfx.Play 2, 200, -6, 15, 20, 0
    Case 3
      AddScore 500 + 50 * chain
      Sfx.Play 2, 60, -1, 13, 10, 0
    Case 4
      guards = guards + 1 : Msg "GUARD +1", 40
      Sfx.Play 2, 80, -2, 14, 16, 0
    Case Else
      novas = novas + 1 : Msg "NOVA +1", 40
      Sfx.Play 2, 80, -2, 14, 16, 0
  End Select
  Web.Burst pX, pY, 8, R_GOLD, 20, 1, 10
  ik(n) = 0
  HudText
End Sub

Sub PowerUp()
  If power < 5 Then
    power = power + 1
    If power = 5 Then Msg "MAXIMUM POWER", 60 Else Msg "POWER UP", 40
  Else
    AddScore 2000
    Msg "2000", 30
  End If
  HudText
End Sub

  If l = bossGap Then
    bossHP = bossHP - 1 : bossF = 3
    Web.Burst x, y, 4, R_FIRE, 30, 0, 12

    AddScore 50
    If bossHP <= 0 Then CoreDown
  Else

' Core: the core's guns. Its gap goes round; it fires harder as it's hurt
Sub Core()
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, ph As Integer, n As Integer
  x = cX : y = cY
  If bossDie > 0 Then
    bossDie = bossDie - 1
    If (bossDie And 3) = 0 Then Web.Burst x - 30 + Rnd(60), y - 30 + Rnd(60), 20, R_FIRE + (Rnd(4) * 8), 50, 0, 40 : Sfx.Play 1, 900, 30, 15, 20, 1
    If bossDie = 0 Then bossOn = 0 : HideCore
    Exit Sub
  End If
  bossT = bossT + 1
  If bossF > 0 Then bossF = bossF - 1
  If (bossT Mod 150) = 0 Then bossGap = (bossGap + 1 + Rnd(3)) And 15
  ph = 1
  If bossHP < bossMax * 2 \ 3 Then ph = 2
  If bossHP < bossMax \ 3 Then ph = 3
  ' twin spirals
  If (bossT Mod 6) = 0 Then
    bossAng = (bossAng + 11) And 255
    Bul.Fire x, y, bossAng, bulSpd - 4, GfxData.S_BULLET, B_PINK
    Bul.Fire x, y, (bossAng + 128) And 255, bulSpd - 4, GfxData.S_BULLET, B_PINK
  End If
  ' rings
  If ph >= 2 And (bossT Mod 60) = 0 Then Ring x, y, 16, bossT And 255, bulSpd - 6, B_GOLD
  ' aimed fans
  If ph >= 3 And (bossT Mod 45) = 20 And alive Then
    n = Bul.Aim(x, y, pX, pY)
    Bul.Fire x, y, n, bulSpd, GfxData.S_BULLET + 2, B_CYAN
    Bul.Fire x, y, (n + 12) And 255, bulSpd, GfxData.S_BULLET + 2, B_CYAN
    Bul.Fire x, y, (n - 12) And 255, bulSpd, GfxData.S_BULLET + 2, B_CYAN
  End If
  ' snappers out of it
  If (bossT Mod 200) = 100 And alivee < 6 Then
    n = FreeThing()
    If n >= 0 Then Put1 n, K_SNAP, Rnd(16), 200
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
Sub Draw()
  Dim n As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, d As Integer, p As Integer, fl As Integer, c As Integer
  ' you: the claw, turned to point in
  If alive Then
    If inv > 0 And (frames And 2) Then
      Spr.Hide SP_CLAW
    Else
      c = cdir(plane)
      If fireAnim > 0 Then fireAnim = fireAnim - 1 : p = 1 Else p = 0
      If (c And 1) = 0 Then
        p = p + GfxData.S_CLAW
        Select Case c
          Case 0 : fl = 0
          Case 2 : fl = Spr.Rotate
          Case 4 : fl = Spr.MirrorY
          Case Else : fl = Spr.Rotate + Spr.MirrorX
        End Select
      Else
        p = p + GfxData.S_CLAWD
        Select Case c
          Case 1 : fl = 0
          Case 3 : fl = Spr.MirrorY
          Case 5 : fl = Spr.MirrorX + Spr.MirrorY
          Case Else : fl = Spr.MirrorX
        End Select
      End If
      Spr.Put SP_CLAW, pX + 24, pY + 24, p, fl
    End If
    If guardT > 0 Then
      Spr.Put SP_GUARD, pX + 16, pY + 16, GfxData.S_GUARD, Spr.Scale2 + Spr.Pal * (frames And 1) * 3
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_GUARD
    End If
  End If
  ' your shots
  For n = 0 To NS - 1
    If sl(n) >= 0 Then
      x = LaneX(sl(n), sz(n)) : y = LaneY(sl(n), sz(n))
      If sz(n) > 1800 Then p = GfxData.S_SHOT Else p = GfxData.S_SHOT + 1
      Spr.Put SP_SHOT + n, x + 24, y + 24, p, 0
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_SHOT + n
    End If
  Next
  ' the pickups
  For n = 0 To NI - 1
    If ik(n) > 0 Then
      x = LaneX(il(n), iz(n)) : y = LaneY(il(n), iz(n))
      Select Case ik(n)
        Case 1 : p = GfxData.S_ITEM + ((frames \ 8) And 1)
        Case 2 : p = GfxData.S_BIGP
        Case 3 : p = GfxData.S_GEM
        Case 4 : p = GfxData.S_GITEM
        Case Else : p = GfxData.S_NITEM
      End Select
      If it(n) > 180 And (frames And 2) Then Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n Else Spr.Put SP_ITEM + n, x + 24, y + 24, p, 0
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_ITEM + n
    End If
  Next
  ' the things: small far down, twice the size near the rim
  For n = 0 To NE - 1
    If ek(n) > 0 Then
      x = LaneX(el(n), ez(n)) : y = LaneY(el(n), ez(n))
      d = ez(n) \ 64
      Select Case ek(n)
        Case K_SNAP : p = GfxData.S_SNAP
        Case K_POD : p = GfxData.S_POD
        Case K_SPIN : p = GfxData.S_SPIN
        Case K_PULS : p = GfxData.S_PULS
        Case K_SEED : p = GfxData.S_SEED
        Case Else : p = GfxData.S_FUSE - 1
      End Select
      fl = 0
      If level > 16 Then fl = Spr.Pal * (6 + (level \ 16) Mod 2)
      If ef(n) > 0 Then fl = Spr.Pal
      If d < 22 Then
        Spr.Put SP_EN + n, x + 24, y + 24, p, fl
      Else
        p = p + 1 + ((frames \ 6) And 1)
        If ek(n) = K_PULS And zap(el(n)) Then p = GfxData.S_PULS + 2
        If ek(n) = K_SPIN And ((frames \ 4) And 1) Then fl = fl + Spr.Rotate
        If d >= 50 Then
          Spr.Put SP_EN + n, x + 16, y + 16, p, fl + Spr.Scale2
        Else
          Spr.Put SP_EN + n, x + 24, y + 24, p, fl
        End If
      End If
    Else
      Spr.Hide SP_EN + n
    End If
  Next
  ' the core: 32 x 32 shown twice the size (4 sprites of 16 x 16 at 2x)
  If bossOn And bossDie = 0 Then
    x = cX : y = cY
    p = GfxData.S_CORE + ((frames \ 10) And 1) * 4
    If bossF > 0 Then fl = Spr.Pal * 8 Else fl = 0
    Spr.Put SP_CORE, x, y, p, fl + Spr.Scale2
    Spr.Put SP_CORE + 1, x + 32, y, p + 1, fl + Spr.Scale2
    Spr.Put SP_CORE + 2, x, y + 32, p + 2, fl + Spr.Scale2
    Spr.Put SP_CORE + 3, x + 32, y + 32, p + 3, fl + Spr.Scale2
    ' its gap: that lane glows
    If (frames And 4) Then
      If lcol(bossGap) = webC Then Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_SEG + bossGap, &HFF : lwas(bossGap) = &HFF
    End If
  End If
End Sub

    plane = (y \ 20) And 15
    alive = 1
    Lights
    alive = 0
    ' the name: every colour in turn
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalLayer2, C_RING + 3, Hx("FFFCF8F0E0E2E7C79F1F1B1D3D7DFDFE", (y \ 3) And 15)
    If (y And 7) = 0 Then Web.Burst LaneX(Rnd(16), 0), LaneY(Rnd(16), 0), 6, R_FIRE + Rnd(8) * 8, 10, 2, 50
    If (y And 63) = 0 Then Web.Burst 128, 100, 24, R_PINK, 40, 1, 30 : wob = 12
    a = Keys.Joystick(0)
    If y > 30 And (Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (a And Keys.JoyFire1)) Then Exit Do
  Loop
  Do
    Sync
    a = Keys.Joystick(0)
  Loop While Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (a And Keys.JoyFire1)
  Tiles.Fill 0
End Sub

Sub GameOver()
  Dim y As Integer
  Spr.HideRange 0, 64
  t = Bul.Clear()
  Msg "GAME OVER", 0
  Tiles.Text 12, 17, "SCORE " & Mid$(Str$(score), 2)
  Tiles.Text 12, 18, "LEVEL " & CStr(level)
  Tiles.Text 12, 19, "BEST CHAIN " & CStr(maxChain)
  For y = 0 To 250
    Sync
    Bul.Step 0, 0, 0
    If (y And 15) = 0 Then Web.Burst 40 + Rnd(176), 40 + Rnd(110), 20, R_FIRE + Rnd(8) * 8, 40, 0, 40
  Next
  Tiles.Fill 0
End Sub

' VText x, y, s, z, c: big letters drawn in lines (only the title's: C H A O T I), z pixels a unit
Sub VText(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, st As String, q As Integer, a As Integer
  For j = 1 To Len(s)
    Select Case Mid$(s, j, 1)
      Case "C" : st = "400000060646"
      Case "H" : st = "000640460343"
      Case "A" : st = "062020461333"
      Case "O" : st = "0040404646060600"
      Case "T" : st = "40002026"
      Case "I" : st = "400020260646"
      Case Else : st = ""
    End Select
    For q = 0 To Len(st) \ 4 - 1
      a = q * 4 + 1
      Web.Line x + Dg(st, a) * z, y + Dg(st, a + 1) * z, x + Dg(st, a + 2) * z, y + Dg(st, a + 3) * z, c
      Web.Line x + Dg(st, a) * z + 1, y + Dg(st, a + 1) * z, x + Dg(st, a + 2) * z + 1, y + Dg(st, a + 3) * z, c
    Next
    x = x + 6 * z
  Next
End Sub

Function Dg(ByVal s As String, ByVal i As Integer) As Integer
  Dg = Asc(Mid$(s, i, 1)) - 48
End Function

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer, mixWas As Integer
Private vv(2) As Integer, stp(2) As Integer, cnt(2) As Integer   ' the volume now, frames a step, to the next
Private silent(2) As Integer       ' 1 = its volume already set to 0

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  mixWas = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0 : silent(i) = 1
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise : silent(ch) = 0
  vv(ch) = volume : stp(ch) = 1
  If volume > 0 Then stp(ch) = frames \ volume
  If stp(ch) < 1 Then stp(ch) = 1
  cnt(ch) = stp(ch)
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer, bt As Integer
  ' (DEFENDER HELLGATE: the channel's mixer bit kept as it goes, not worked out with ^ each time;
  ' a silent channel's volume written only once)
  mix = &H3F : bt = 1
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      ' the volume down one every stp frames (worked out once, in Play: no dividing every frame)
      cnt(i) = cnt(i) - 1
      If cnt(i) <= 0 Then
        cnt(i) = stp(i)
        If vv(i) > 1 Then vv(i) = vv(i) - 1
      End If
      v = vv(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (bt * 8)
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not bt
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
      If left(i) = 0 Then silent(i) = 0
    ElseIf silent(i) = 0 Then
      W 8 + i, 0
      silent(i) = 1
    End If
    bt = bt * 2
  Next
  If mix <> mixWas Then W 7, mix : mixWas = mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld a, h
            add a, #C0
            ld h, a
            ex de, hl
            ld a, c                 ; BC = count * 32 (count 1 - 255: tile 0 run of 0 not used)
            ld b, 0
            ld c, a
            push hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop hl
            ldir
            jr ld_run

            ld bc, #303B            ; sprite patterns from pattern 0

            out (c), a
            ld hl, pats

            inc b
            ld a, 11
            out (c), a

            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec de

files.text:
' Web - CHAOTIC's Layer 2: the web's lines and the particles, in Z80.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Layer 2 is 256 x 192, one byte a pixel, bank 16 (8K pages 32-37, 32 lines each), put in at
' #C000 through MMU slot 6 while drawing, then bank 5's page 10 back (the tilemap's tiles live
' there). One screen, not two: the web is drawn once a level, so nothing needs clearing each frame.
' The pixels are colour numbers into Layer 2's palette (Main sets it): 0 is see-through (the
' copper's background shows), the web's lines are numbered by lane so Main can light a lane
' up just by changing its colours.
'
' The particles: up to 160 blocks of 2 x 2 pixels (on even x and y, so a block never crosses a
' page), each 32 bytes in pt():
'   0-1 x (1/256ths of a pixel, the pixel in byte 1), 2-3 y, 4-5 x speed, 6-7 y speed (signed,
'   1/256ths of a pixel a frame), 8 life (frames left, 0 = free), 9 its colour ramp (the first of
'   8 palette numbers, brightest first), 10-13 the 4 pixels it covers (top left, top right, bottom
'   left, bottom right), 14-15 the top left's address, 16 its page (0 = covering nothing),
'   17 1 = speeding up (the warp), 18-31 spare.
' Each frame Step first puts back what every particle covered (last to first, so dots on top of
' each other come off in the right order), then moves them all and draws them again, saving
' what's under each. So they fly over the web without spoiling it.
Option Explicit

Const NP = 160
Private pt(5119) As Byte
Private six As Integer, cnt As Integer, rnd As Integer, nxt As Integer, tmp As Integer
Private bx As Integer, by As Integer, bn As Integer, br As Integer, bs As Integer, bm As Integer, bl As Integer
Private ba As Integer, bst As Integer, nlive As Integer

' Init: no particles, the screen cleared
Public Sub Init()
  rnd = 12345
  Kill
  Clear
End Sub

' Clear: the whole screen colour 0 (two frames' work: do it between levels)
Public Sub Clear()
#asm
            ld a, 32
            ld ({tmp}), a
cl_pg:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, ({tmp})
            out (c), a
            ld hl, #C000
            ld (hl), 0
            ld de, #C001
            ld bc, 8191
            ldir
            ld hl, {tmp}
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 38
            jr nz, cl_pg
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Kill: every particle gone (without putting back what they covered: after a Clear)
Public Sub Kill()
#asm
            ld hl, {pt}
            ld de, {pt} + 1
            ld (hl), 0
            ld bc, 5119
            ldir
            xor a
            ld ({nlive}), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Line x0, y0, x1, y1, c: a line in colour c (all on the screen: 0-255, 0-191)
Public Sub Line(ByVal x0 As Integer, ByVal y0 As Integer, ByVal x1 As Integer, ByVal y1 As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; x0
            pop hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; y0
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ln_x1 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ln_y1 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ln_c1 + 1), a
            ld (ln_c2 + 1), a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            ; dx, sx
ln_x1:
            ld a, 0
            sub e
            ld c, 1
            jr nc, ln_dxp
            neg
            ld c, 255
ln_dxp:
            ld (ln_dx1 + 1), a
            ld (ln_dx2 + 1), a
            ld (ln_dxa + 1), a
            ld a, c
            ld (ln_sx1 + 1), a
            ld (ln_sx2 + 1), a
            ; dy, sy
ln_y1:
            ld a, 0
            sub d
            ld c, 1
            jr nc, ln_dyp
            neg
            ld c, 255
ln_dyp:
            ld (ln_dy1 + 1), a
            ld (ln_dy2 + 1), a
            ld (ln_dyb + 1), a
            ld a, c
            ld (ln_sy1 + 1), a
            ld (ln_sy2 + 1), a
ln_dyb:
            ld c, 0                 ; dy
ln_dxa:
            ld a, 0                 ; dx
            cp c
            jp c, ln_ymaj
            ; ---- along x: dx + 1 pixels
            inc a
            ld ({cnt}), a
            ld a, (ln_dx1 + 1)
            srl a
            ld ({tmp}), a           ; err
lx_lp:
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            add a, 32
            ld bc, #253B
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e
ln_c1:
            ld (hl), 0
            ld a, e
ln_sx1:
            add a, 1
            ld e, a
            ld a, ({tmp})
ln_dy1:
            sub 0
            jr nc, lx_ok
ln_dx1:
            add a, 0
            ld ({tmp}), a
            ld a, d
ln_sy1:
            add a, 1
            ld d, a
            jr lx_nx
lx_ok:
            ld ({tmp}), a
lx_nx:
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jr nz, lx_lp
            jp ln_done
ln_ymaj:
            ; ---- along y: dy + 1 pixels
            ld a, c
            inc a
            ld ({cnt}), a
            ld a, c
            srl a
            ld ({tmp}), a
ly_lp:
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            add a, 32
            ld bc, #253B
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e
ln_c2:
            ld (hl), 0
            ld a, d
ln_sy2:
            add a, 1
            ld d, a
            ld a, ({tmp})
ln_dx2:
            sub 0
            jr nc, ly_ok
ln_dy2:
            add a, 0
            ld ({tmp}), a
            ld a, e
ln_sx2:
            add a, 1
            ld e, a
            jr ly_nx
ly_ok:
            ld ({tmp}), a
ly_nx:
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jr nz, ly_lp
ln_done:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Burst x, y, n, ramp, spd, mode, life: n particles from x, y (pixels). ramp: the palette
' number of their brightest colour (8 in a row, fading). spd: how fast (1-64: 64 is 4 pixels a
' frame at most). mode: 0 any way at any speed up to spd, 1 a ring (evenly round, all at spd),
' 2 speeding up (the warp's stars), 3 both. life: about how many frames they last (+ up to 15);
' they're brightest until their last 32 frames, then fade through the ramp.
Public Sub Burst(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal ramp As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal mode As Integer, ByVal life As Integer)
  If n < 1 Then Exit Sub
  bx = x : by = y : bn = n : br = ramp : bs = spd : bm = mode : bl = life
  bst = 256 \ n
  ba = Rnd(256)
  Spawn
End Sub

Private Sub Spawn()
#asm
            ld ({six}), ix
bu_lp:
            ; a free one, from where the last search stopped
            ld a, 160
            ld ({cnt}), a
bu_find:
            ld a, ({nxt})
            inc a
            cp 160
            jr c, bu_n1
            xor a
bu_n1:
            ld ({nxt}), a
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ex de, hl
            ld ix, {pt}
            add ix, de
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            or a
            jr z, bu_got
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jr nz, bu_find
            jp bu_done
bu_got:
            ; the random number (xorshift)
            ld hl, ({rnd})
            ld a, h
            rra
            ld a, l
            rra
            xor h
            ld h, a
            ld a, l
            rra
            ld a, h
            rra
            xor l
            ld l, a
            xor h
            ld h, a
            ld ({rnd}), hl
            ; the speed: spd (a ring) or random up to spd
            ld a, ({bm})
            and 1
            ld a, ({bs})
            jr nz, bu_sp
            ld d, a
            ld e, l
bu_zm0:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            ld a, d
            inc a
bu_sp:
            ld (bu_s1 + 1), a
            ld (bu_s2 + 1), a
            ; the way: random, or the ring's next
            ld a, ({bm})
            and 1
            jr z, bu_rw
            ld a, ({ba})
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({bst})
            add a, c
            ld ({ba}), a
            ld a, c
            jr bu_wy
bu_rw:
            ld a, h
bu_wy:
            ld ({tmp}), a
            ; vx = sin(a) * s / 8
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, bu_h1
            inc h
bu_h1:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, bu_p1
            neg
bu_p1:
            ld d, a
bu_s1:
            ld e, 0
bu_zm1:
            db #ED, #30
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, bu_v1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
bu_v1:
            ld (ix + 4), e
            ld (ix + 5), d
            ld a, ({tmp})           ; vy = sin(a + 64) * s / 8
            add a, 64
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, bu_h2
            inc h
bu_h2:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, bu_p2
            neg
bu_p2:
            ld d, a
bu_s2:
            ld e, 0
bu_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, bu_v2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
bu_v2:
            ld (ix + 6), e
            ld (ix + 7), d
            ld (ix + 0), 128
            ld a, ({bx})
            ld (ix + 1), a
            ld (ix + 2), 128
            ld a, ({by})
            ld (ix + 3), a
            ld a, ({rnd})
            and 15
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({bl})
            add a, c
            jr nz, bu_lf
            inc a
bu_lf:
            ld (ix + 8), a
            ld a, ({br})
            ld (ix + 9), a
            ld (ix + 16), 0
            ld a, ({bm})
            srl a
            and 1
            ld (ix + 17), a
            ld hl, {bn}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, bu_lp
bu_done:
            ld ix, ({six})
#endasm
End Sub

' Step: every particle: what it covered put back, moved, drawn again (once a frame)
Public Sub Step()
#asm
            ld ({six}), ix
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            ; ---- put back what they covered, the last first
            ld ix, {pt} + 5088
            ld a, 160
            ld ({cnt}), a
            ld de, -32
ps_un:
            ld a, (ix + 16)
            or a
            jr z, ps_un_n
            ld bc, #253B
            out (c), a
            ld l, (ix + 14)
            ld h, (ix + 15)
            ld a, (ix + 10)
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            ld a, (ix + 11)
            ld (hl), a
            inc h
            ld a, (ix + 13)
            ld (hl), a
            dec l
            ld a, (ix + 12)
            ld (hl), a
            ld (ix + 16), 0
ps_un_n:
            add ix, de
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jr nz, ps_un
            ; ---- move and draw, the first first
            ld ix, {pt}
            ld a, 160
            ld ({cnt}), a
            xor a
            ld ({nlive}), a
ps_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            or a
            jp z, ps_next
            dec a
            ld (ix + 8), a
            jp z, ps_next
            ld a, (ix + 17)
            or a
            jr z, ps_mv
            ; speeding up: v += v / 16
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)
            ld e, l
            ld d, h
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 4), l
            ld (ix + 5), h
            ld l, (ix + 6)
            ld h, (ix + 7)
            ld e, l
            ld d, h
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 6), l
            ld (ix + 7), h
ps_mv:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            add a, (ix + 4)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            adc a, (ix + 5)
            ld (ix + 1), a
            cp 4
            jp c, ps_kill
            cp 252
            jp nc, ps_kill
            and #FE                 ; 2 x 2 blocks: x and y even
            ld e, a
            ld a, (ix + 2)
            add a, (ix + 6)
            ld (ix + 2), a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            adc a, (ix + 7)
            ld (ix + 3), a
            cp 190
            jp nc, ps_kill
            and #FE
            ld d, a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e                 ; HL = #C000 + (y And 31) * 256 + x
            ld (ix + 14), l
            ld (ix + 15), h
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            add a, 32               ; the page: 32 + y / 32
            ld (ix + 16), a
            ld bc, #253B
            out (c), a
            ; the colour: the ramp's brightest while life >= 32, then a step darker each 4
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            cp 32
            jr c, ps_f
            xor a
            jr ps_c7
ps_f:
            neg
            add a, 32
            srl a
            srl a
ps_c7:
            add a, (ix + 9)
            ld d, a
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 10), a
            ld (hl), d
            inc l
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 11), a
            ld (hl), d
            inc h
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 13), a
            ld (hl), d
            dec l
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 12), a
            ld (hl), d
            ld hl, {nlive}
            inc (hl)
            jr ps_next
ps_kill:
            ld (ix + 8), 0
ps_next:
            ld de, 32
            add ix, de
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, ps_lp
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld ix, ({six})
#endasm
End Sub

' Live(): how many particles are flying
Public Function Live() As Integer
  Live = nlive And 255
End Function

files.name: Cop.cls
files.text:
' Cop - CHAOTIC's copper: on every line of the picture it sets the fallback colour (NextReg #4A:
' what shows where every layer is see-through - the background) and Layer 2's sideways scroll
' (NextReg #16: the web wobbles). (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' The background is a band of colours from g() that rolls down the screen (phase); a flash
' colour fills it all; amp makes Layer 2 wobble side to side (a sine wave rolling down).
' The list: every other line of the 192 x (WAIT line, MOVE #4A, MOVE #16) = 6 bytes, black under
' the picture, the end: 582 bytes (every other line: half the time to send it, and the bands are
' 8 lines deep anyway).
' A frame:  Cop.Build phase, amp, flash   (any time)
'           Frame : Cop.Show              (straight after Frame, in the top border)
Option Explicit

Private cop(583) As Byte
Private g(255) As Byte
Private ph As Integer, am As Integer, fl As Integer, cnt As Integer

' Grad i, c: background colour i (0-255) of the rolling band is c (RRRGGGBB)
Public Sub Grad(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  g(i And 255) = c
End Sub

' Build phase, amp, flash: the list for the next frame. phase rolls the band (0-255), amp the
' wobble (0 none - 127 about 16 pixels each way), flash not 0: the whole background that colour
Public Sub Build(ByVal phase As Integer, ByVal amp As Integer, ByVal flash As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ph}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (cb_amp + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({fl}), a
            ld hl, {cop}
            ld c, 0                 ; the line
cb_lp:
            ld (hl), #80            ; WAIT line c, at the start of the line
            inc hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #4A            ; the background
            inc hl
            ld a, ({fl})
            or a
            jr nz, cb_fl
            ld a, c
            srl a
            ld e, a
            ld a, ({ph})
            add a, e
            ld de, {g}
            add a, e
            ld e, a
            jr nc, cb_g1
            inc d
cb_g1:
            ld a, (de)
cb_fl:
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #16            ; Layer 2's scroll
            inc hl
            ; sin(line * 4 + phase * 2) * amp / 128
            ld a, ({ph})
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld a, c
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, e
            ld de, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, e
            ld e, a
            jr nc, cb_g2
            inc d
cb_g2:
            ld a, (de)
            ld b, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, cb_p
            neg
cb_p:
            ld d, a
cb_amp:
            ld e, 0
cb_zm:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            ld a, d
            bit 7, b
            jr z, cb_v
            neg
cb_v:
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            inc c
            inc c
            ld a, c
            cp 192
            jr nz, cb_lp
            ld (hl), #80            ; under the picture: the background black
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 192
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #4A
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #FF            ; the end: a line that never comes
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #FF
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the list to the copper (straight after Frame): stopped, written from the start, started
' again (from the top at every frame)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #61
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #60
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld hl, {cop}
            ld e, 145
cs_lp1:
            ld a, (hl)              ; 582 bytes: 4 x 145, then 2
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, cs_lp1
            ld e, 2
cs_lp2:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, cs_lp2
            dec b
            ld a, #62
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, #C0
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Off: the copper stopped, the background black, no wobble
Public Sub Off()
  Nx.Reg &H62, 0
  Nx.Reg &H4A, 0
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0
End Sub
