files.text:
' Bul - CHAOTIC's bullets: 64 enemy bullets as hardware sprites 64-127, moved, checked and
' drawn in Z80 every frame. From IDOL WINGS's (shots, boxes and the beam taken out: CHAOTIC's
' shots fly down the lanes, worked out in BASIC). (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Coordinates are Layer 2's (the paper: 0-255 across, 0-191 down); Step puts them on the
' sprites' screen (32 more each way). Positions are centres. Bullets move in 1/256ths of a pixel
' (an angle and a speed: Fire); they go when they leave the paper. Step tells you if one is on
' the player (within r pixels of the claw's middle).
' A frame:  Bul.Step px, py, r   (moves all, writes the sprites' table)
'           Frame : Bul.Show     (the table to the hardware)
Option Explicit

Private eb(639) As Byte           ' 64 bullets x 10: x (lo, hi), y (lo, hi), vx, vy, pattern (255 = none), palette
Private att(319) As Byte          ' 64 sprites x 5
Private hitF As Integer, live As Integer, cnt As Integer, ang As Integer, tmp As Integer
Private vx As Integer, vy As Integer, six As Integer
Private atn(16) As Integer

' Init: everything cleared
Public Sub Init()
  atn(0) = 0 : atn(1) = 3 : atn(2) = 5 : atn(3) = 8 : atn(4) = 10 : atn(5) = 12 : atn(6) = 15 : atn(7) = 17
  atn(8) = 19 : atn(9) = 21 : atn(10) = 23 : atn(11) = 25 : atn(12) = 26 : atn(13) = 28 : atn(14) = 29
  atn(15) = 31 : atn(16) = 32
  tmp = Sines()
  Reset
End Sub

' Reset: no bullets
Public Sub Reset()
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 64
rs_b:
            ld (hl), 255
            add hl, de
            djnz rs_b
            ld hl, {att}
            ld b, 64
rs_a:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #40
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            djnz rs_a
#endasm
End Sub

' Clear(): every enemy bullet gone (a bomb, a boss beaten): how many there were
Public Function Clear() As Integer
#asm
            ld hl, {eb} + 8
            ld de, 10
            ld bc, 64 * 256
cl_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, cl_n
            ld (hl), 255
            inc c
cl_n:
            add hl, de
            djnz cl_lp
            pop hl
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fire x, y, a, spd, pat, pal: an enemy bullet from x, y going way a (0-255: 0 down, 64 right,
' 128 up, 192 left) at spd sixteenths of a pixel a frame, sprite pattern pat in palette pal
Public Sub Fire(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal spd As Integer, ByVal pat As Integer, ByVal pal As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_y + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ang}), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_s1 + 1), a
            ld (fi_s2 + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fi_p + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (fi_c + 1), a
            ld hl, {eb} + 8         ; a free one
            ld de, 10
            ld b, 64
fi_find:
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 255
            jr z, fi_got
            add hl, de
            djnz fi_find
            jp fi_done
fi_got:
            ld de, -8
            add hl, de
            ld ({tmp}), hl
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vx = sin(a) * spd / 8
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n1
            inc h
fi_n1:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p1
            neg
fi_p1:
            ld d, a
fi_s1:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm1:
            db #ED, #30             ; mul d, e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v1
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v1:
            ld ({vx}), de
            ld a, ({ang})           ; vy = sin(a + 64) * spd / 8
            add a, 64
            ld hl, fn_bul_sines_sn_data
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            jr nc, fi_n2
            inc h
fi_n2:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            bit 7, a
            jr z, fi_p2
            neg
fi_p2:
            ld d, a
fi_s2:
            ld e, 0
fi_zm2:
            db #ED, #30
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            bit 7, c
            jr z, fi_v2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
fi_v2:
            ld ({vy}), de
            ld hl, ({tmp})
            ld (hl), 128
            inc hl
fi_x:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 128
            inc hl
fi_y:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld de, ({vx})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, ({vy})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
fi_p:
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
fi_c:
            ld (hl), 0
fi_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Step px, py, r: every bullet moved; Hit() true if one is within r pixels (across and down) of
' px, py
Public Sub Step(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer, ByVal r As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_px + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_py + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_r1 + 1), a
            ld (st_r2 + 1), a
            add a, a
            inc a
            ld (st_d1 + 1), a
            ld (st_d2 + 1), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            xor a
            ld ({hitF}), a
            ld ({live}), a
            ld ix, {eb}
            ld de, {att}
            ld a, 64
            ld ({cnt}), a
st_lp:
            ld a, (ix + 8)
            cp 255
            jp z, st_free
            ld c, a                 ; the pattern
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            ld b, a                 ; the old x
            ld a, (ix + 0)          ; x += vx
            add a, (ix + 4)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            adc a, (ix + 5)
            ld (ix + 1), a
            sub b                   ; off the side: it jumped across (wrapped)
            add a, 16
            cp 32
            jr nc, st_kill
            ld a, (ix + 1)
            cp 2
            jr c, st_kill
            cp 254
            jr nc, st_kill
            ld a, (ix + 2)          ; y += vy
            add a, (ix + 6)
            ld (ix + 2), a
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            adc a, (ix + 7)
            ld (ix + 3), a
            cp 190
            jr nc, st_kill
st_py:
            sub 0                   ; on the player: within r both ways
st_r1:
            add a, 3
st_d1:
            cp 7
            jr nc, st_nohit
            ld a, (ix + 1)
st_px:
            sub 0
st_r2:
            add a, 3
st_d2:
            cp 7
            jr nc, st_nohit
            ld a, 1
            ld ({hitF}), a
st_nohit:
            ld hl, {live}
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (ix + 1)          ; sprite x = x + 24 (9 bits)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld b, 0
            jr nc, st_x8
            inc b
st_x8:
            ld a, (ix + 3)
            add a, 24
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, (ix + 9)
            or b
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            jr st_next
st_kill:
            ld (ix + 8), 255
st_free:
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, #40
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            xor a
            ld (de), a
            inc de
st_next:
            ld bc, 10
            add ix, bc
            ld hl, {cnt}
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, st_lp
            ld ix, ({six})
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to sprites 64-127 (straight after Frame)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld bc, #303B
            ld a, 64
            out (c), a
            ld hl, {att}
            ld bc, 160 * 256 + #57
            otir
            ld b, 160
            otir
#endasm
End Sub

' Hit(): True when a bullet was on the player in the last Step
Public Function Hit() As Integer
  Hit = hitF
End Function

' Count(): the enemy bullets flying
Public Function Count() As Integer
  Count = live
End Function

' Aim(x, y, tx, ty): the way (0-255, as Fire's) from x, y to tx, ty
Public Function Aim(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal tx As Integer, ByVal ty As Integer) As Integer
  Dim dx As Integer, dy As Integer, ax As Integer, ay As Integer, t As Integer
  dx = tx - x : dy = ty - y
  ax = Abs(dx) : ay = Abs(dy)
  If ax = 0 And ay = 0 Then
    Aim = 0
    Exit Function
  End If
  If ax <= ay Then
    t = atn(ax * 16 \ ay)
  Else
    t = 64 - atn(ay * 16 \ ax)
  End If
  If dy >= 0 Then
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = t Else Aim = (256 - t) And 255
  Else
    If dx >= 0 Then Aim = 128 - t Else Aim = 128 + t
  End If
End Function
